STEP 2. Check the input signal (by using scan tool 
MB991502).
Check the input signals from the transmitter switches.
CAUTION
To prevent damage to scan tool MB991502, always turn the 
ignition switch to the "LOCK" (OFF) position before 
connecting or disconnecting scan tool MB991502.
(1) Connect scan tool MB991502 to the data link connector.
(2) Check that the tone alarm of scan tool MB991502 sounds 
when the input signal enters.
Q: Does the tone alarm of scan tool MB991502 sound when 
the input signal enters?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. All the doors should be 
locked or unlocked by using the transmitter.
NO : Check the transmitter input circuit. Refer to Inspection 
Procedure O-18 (P.54B-282).
STEP 3. Check the input signal (by using a voltmeter).
Check the input signals from the transmitter switches.
(1) Use special tool MB991529 to connect a voltmeter between 
ground terminal 4 or 5 and ETACS-ECU terminal 9 of the 
data link connector.
(2) Check that the voltmeter indicator deflects once when the 
input signal enters.
Q: Does the voltmeter indicator deflect?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. All the doors should be 
locked or unlocked by using the transmitter.
NO : Check the transmitter input circuit. Refer to Inspection 
Procedure O-21 (P.54B-282).
